about: The 24 jobs people phone about, chosen from catalogue.json by share of orders as the lead job (share_of_orders.lead). Three blocks fold a second catalogue job into the same phone conversation: front brakes (pads and rotors, pads alone), rear brakes (the same), the A/C (performance check, then a recharge). The 24 blocks cover catalogue jobs that are lead job on 74 % of English orders. Left out by share: rear shock absorbers (tied with the control arm, the CV axle and the water pump at 0.79 %; the last three are taken because callers describe them in their own words more often), and every job under 0.79 %.
